// src/core/module-registry.ts
import { Schema as Schema2 } from "effect";
var JsonValueSchema = Schema2.suspend(() => Schema2.Union(Schema2.String, Schema2.Number.pipe(Schema2.finite()), Schema2.Boolean, Schema2.Null, Schema2.Array(JsonValueSchema), Schema2.Record({ key: Schema2.String, value: JsonValueSchema })));
var StoredModuleStateSchema = Schema2.Struct({ kind: Schema2.String, revision: Schema2.Int.pipe(Schema2.nonNegative()) }, { key: Schema2.String, value: JsonValueSchema });
function defineModule(definition2) {
  const parse4 = (value) => {
    const data = Schema2.decodeUnknownSync(definition2.data, { onExcessProperty: "error" })(value);
    definition2.validate?.(data);
    return data;
  };
  const parseState5 = (value) => Schema2.decodeUnknownSync(definition2.state, { onExcessProperty: "error" })(value);
  const parseAction = (value) => Schema2.decodeUnknownSync(definition2.action, { onExcessProperty: "error" })(value);
  return Object.freeze({
    kind: definition2.kind,
    schemaVersion: definition2.schemaVersion,
    description: definition2.description,
    parse: parse4,
    parseState: parseState5,
    parseAction,
    initial(value) {
      return definition2.initial(parse4(value));
    },
    update(value, previous, actionValue) {
      const data = parse4(value), state = parseState5(previous), action = parseAction(actionValue);
      if (state.revision !== action.expectedRevision) throw Error("This module changed. Keep your selection and reload its current state.");
      return parseState5(definition2.update(data, state, action));
    },
    text(value, stateValue) {
      const data = parse4(value);
      return definition2.text(data, stateValue === void 0 ? definition2.initial(data) : parseState5(stateValue));
    }
  });
}
function createModuleRegistry(entries) {
  const installed = Object.freeze({ ...entries });
  for (const [key, entry2] of Object.entries(installed)) if (entry2.kind !== key || !Number.isInteger(entry2.schemaVersion) || entry2.schemaVersion < 1) throw Error("Invalid installed module definition.");
  const entry = (value) => {
    const header = Schema2.decodeUnknownSync(Schema2.Struct({ kind: Schema2.String }))(value);
    if (!Object.hasOwn(installed, header.kind)) throw Error("This module is not installed. A readable answer remains available.");
    return installed[header.kind];
  };
  return Object.freeze({
    entries: installed,
    parse(value) {
      return entry(value).parse(value);
    },
    initial(value) {
      return entry(value).initial(value);
    },
    update(value, state, action) {
      return entry(value).update(value, state, action);
    },
    action(value, action) {
      return entry(value).parseAction(action);
    },
    text(value, state) {
      return entry(value).text(value, state);
    }
  });
}

var composerKinds = ["explain", "create", "experiment", "procedure"];

}

// src/core/task-session.ts
var text = Schema3.String.pipe(Schema3.maxLength(1e5));
var id = Schema3.String.pipe(Schema3.minLength(1), Schema3.maxLength(200));
var ComposerKindSchema = Schema3.Literal(...composerKinds);
var BrowserObservationSchema = Schema3.Struct({
  id,
  taskId: id,
  browserId: id,
  documentId: id,
  url: text,
  title: text,
  text,
  digest: id,
  targets: Schema3.Array(Schema3.Struct({ id, role: text, label: text, href: Schema3.optional(text), value: Schema3.optional(text) })).pipe(Schema3.maxItems(100))
});
var BrowserIntentSchema = Schema3.Union(
  Schema3.Struct({ kind: Schema3.Literal("click"), snapshotId: id, targetId: id }),
  Schema3.Struct({ kind: Schema3.Literal("fill"), snapshotId: id, targetId: id, value: text })
);
var BrowserOperationSchema = Schema3.Struct({
  id,
  intent: BrowserIntentSchema,
  status: Schema3.Literal("proposed", "executing", "observed", "uncertain", "failed", "retired"),
  reason: text,
  result: Schema3.optional(BrowserObservationSchema),
  receipt: Schema3.optional(Schema3.Struct({ status: Schema3.Int, url: text, body: text })),
  reconciliation: Schema3.optional(Schema3.Struct({ id, outcome: Schema3.Literal("completed", "not-completed", "uncertain"), basis: Schema3.Literal("user-reviewed-observation"), note: text, observation: BrowserObservationSchema })),
  error: Schema3.optional(text)
});
var TaskSessionSchema = Schema3.Struct({
  revision: Schema3.Int.pipe(Schema3.nonNegative()),
  draft: text,
  draftKind: Schema3.optional(ComposerKindSchema),
  draftRevision: Schema3.optional(Schema3.Int.pipe(Schema3.nonNegative())),
  contextRevision: Schema3.optional(Schema3.Int.pipe(Schema3.nonNegative())),
  browserContext: Schema3.optional(Schema3.Struct({ origin: text, url: text, requestId: id })),
  runs: Schema3.Array(Schema3.Struct({
    id,
    endpointKey: id,
    origin: text,
    browserId: id,
    initialObservation: BrowserObservationSchema,
    operations: Schema3.Array(BrowserOperationSchema).pipe(Schema3.maxItems(64))
  })).pipe(Schema3.maxItems(100)),
  moduleStates: Schema3.Array(Schema3.Struct({ artifactId: id, artifactRevision: Schema3.Int, moduleId: Schema3.optional(id), state: StoredModuleStateSchema })).pipe(Schema3.maxItems(200))
});
var emptyTaskSession = () => ({ revision: 0, draft: "", runs: [], moduleStates: [] });
function recoverTaskSession(session) {
  return { ...session, revision: session.revision + 1, runs: session.runs.map((run) => ({
    ...run,
    operations: run.operations.map((operation2) => operation2.status === "executing" ? { ...operation2, status: "uncertain", error: "The host stopped during this action. Inspect the website before another attempt." } : operation2.status === "proposed" ? { ...operation2, status: "retired", error: "Restart retired this unexecuted proposal. Observe and approve a fresh target." } : operation2)
  })) };
}

var list = (schema) => Schema4.mutable(Schema4.Array(schema));
var optionalText = Schema4.optional(Schema4.String);
var sourceFields = {

  kind: Schema4.Literal("text", "image", "window"),

  content: Schema4.String,
  role: Schema4.Literal("fact", "style", "inspiration"),

var Step = Schema4.Struct({ intent: Schema4.String, target: Schema4.String, preconditions: list(Schema4.Struct({ key: Schema4.String, equals: Schema4.String })), expectedResult: Schema4.String });

var Checkpoint = Schema4.Struct({ id: Schema4.String, note: Schema4.String, createdAt: Schema4.String, sourceRefs: list(Ref), artifacts: list(Schema4.Struct({ artifactId: Schema4.String, revision: Schema4.Int })) });
var Proposal = Schema4.Struct({ id: Schema4.String, taskId: Schema4.String, artifactId: Schema4.String, revision: Schema4.Int, path: Schema4.String, parentRealPath: Schema4.String, parentDevice: Schema4.String, parentInode: Schema4.String, artifactDigest: Schema4.String, sourceRefs: list(Ref), byteLength: Schema4.Int, digest: Schema4.String, createdAt: Schema4.String });

var taskFields = { id: Schema4.String, title: Schema4.String, goal: Schema4.String, status: Schema4.Literal("active", "paused"), createdAt: Schema4.String, updatedAt: Schema4.String, sources: list(Source), artifacts: list(Artifact), requests: list(Request), procedures: list(Procedure), checkpoints: list(Checkpoint), actions: list(Action), memory: Schema4.Struct({ enabled: Schema4.Literal(false) }) };
var LegacyStateSchema = Schema4.Struct({ schemaVersion: Schema4.Literal(1), tasks: list(Schema4.Struct(taskFields)), usedRequestIds: list(Schema4.String) });

var StateSchema = Schema4.Struct({ schemaVersion: Schema4.Literal(2), tasks: list(TaskSchema), usedRequestIds: list(Schema4.String) });
var StateValidationError = class extends Error {
  constructor(cause) {
    super("Task-store draft failed validation; existing data was preserved.", { cause });
    this.name = "StateValidationError";
  }
};
function readState(dataDir) {
  return Effect.tryPromise({
    try: async () => {
      try {
        const raw = await readFile(join(dataDir, "tasks.json"), "utf8");
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && "schemaVersion" in parsed && parsed.schemaVersion === 1) {
          const legacy = Schema4.decodeUnknownSync(LegacyStateSchema, { onExcessProperty: "error" })(parsed);
          return { ...legacy, schemaVersion: 2 };
        }
        return Schema4.decodeUnknownSync(StateSchema, { onExcessProperty: "error" })(parsed);
      } catch (error) {
        if (isCode(error, "ENOENT")) return { schemaVersion: 2, tasks: [], usedRequestIds: [] };
        throw new Error("Task store is unreadable or incompatible; existing data was preserved.", { cause: error });
      }
    },
    catch: (error) => error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error))
  });
}
function writeState(dataDir, state) {
  return Effect.tryPromise({
    try: async () => {
      let validated;
      try {
        validated = Schema4.decodeUnknownSync(StateSchema, { onExcessProperty: "error" })(state);
      } catch (cause) {
        throw new StateValidationError(cause);
      }
      await mkdir(dataDir, { recursive: true, mode: 448 });
      const temporaryPath = join(dataDir, `.tasks-${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
      try {
        const file = await open(temporaryPath, "wx", 384);
        try {
          await file.writeFile(JSON.stringify(validated));
          await file.sync();
        } finally {
          await file.close();
        }
        await rename(temporaryPath, join(dataDir, "tasks.json"));
        const directory = await open(dataDir, "r");
        try {
          await directory.sync();
        } finally {
          await directory.close();
        }
      } finally {
        await rm(temporaryPath, { force: true });
      }
    },
    catch: (error) => error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error))
  });
}
function isCode(error, code) {
  return error instanceof Error && "code" in error && error.code === code;
}

// src/core/experiments.ts
var units = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["1", "m", "s", "kg", "K", "A", "mol", "cd", "USD"]);
var fail = (reason2) => {
  throw new Error(`Invalid experiment: ${reason2}`);
};
var dimensions = (unit = "1") => {
  if (typeof unit !== "string" || unit.length < 1 || unit.length > 80) return fail("unit must contain 1\u201380 characters");
  const tokens = unit.trim().split(/([*/·])/u);
  if (tokens.length > 15) return fail("unit has too many factors");
  const result = {};
  for (let index = 0; index < tokens.length; index += 2) {
    const match = /^(1|[A-Za-z]+)(?:\^(-?\d{1,2}))?$/.exec(tokens[index]?.trim() ?? "");
    if (!match || !units.has(match[1])) return fail("unsupported unit or syntax");
    const exponent = match[2] === void 0 ? 1 : Number(match[2]);
    if (Math.abs(exponent) > 8) return fail("unit power must be from -8 to 8");
    if (match[1] === "1") continue;
    const power = exponent * (index > 0 && tokens[index - 1] === "/" ? -1 : 1);
    result[match[1]] = (result[match[1]] ?? 0) + power;
    if (Math.abs(result[match[1]]) > 16) return fail("unit dimension exceeds bounds");
  }
  return result;
};
var unitLabel = (d) => Object.keys(d).filter((k) => d[k] !== 0).sort().map((k) => d[k] === 1 ? k : `${k}^${d[k]}`).join(" \xB7 ") || "1";
var combine = (a, b, sign) => {
  const result = { ...a };
  for (const [key, power] of Object.entries(b)) result[key] = (result[key] ?? 0) + power * sign;
  return result;
};
function evaluateExperiment(spec, inputs) {
  if (!Array.isArray(spec.variables) || spec.variables.length > 16 || !Array.isArray(spec.assumptions) || spec.assumptions.length > 16) fail("too many inputs or assumptions");
  const variables = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  for (const variable of spec.variables) {
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,31}$/.test(variable.name) || variables.has(variable.name)) fail("invalid or duplicate variable");
    if (!Number.isFinite(variable.min) || !Number.isFinite(variable.max) || variable.min > variable.max) fail("invalid input bounds");
    const value = inputs[variable.name];
    if (!Object.hasOwn(inputs, variable.name) || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < variable.min || value > variable.max) fail(`input ${variable.name} is outside bounds`);
    variables.set(variable.name, { value, dimensions: dimensions(variable.unit) });
  }
  if (Object.keys(inputs).some((name2) => !variables.has(name2))) fail("unknown input");
  let nodes = 0;
  const evaluate3 = (expression, depth) => {
    if (++nodes > 128 || depth > 20 || !expression || typeof expression !== "object") return fail("expression exceeds bounds");
    let result2;
    switch (expression.op) {
      case "constant":
        result2 = { value: expression.value, dimensions: dimensions(expression.unit) };
        break;
      case "variable": {
        const value = variables.get(expression.name);
        if (!value) return fail("unknown variable");
        result2 = value;
        break;
      }
      case "power": {
        if (!Number.isInteger(expression.exponent) || Math.abs(expression.exponent) > 8) return fail("power must be an integer from -8 to 8");
        const base = evaluate3(expression.base, depth + 1);
        result2 = { value: base.value ** expression.exponent, dimensions: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(base.dimensions).map(([unit, power]) => [unit, power * expression.exponent])) };
        break;
      }
      case "add":
      case "subtract":
      case "multiply":
      case "divide": {
        const a = evaluate3(expression.left, depth + 1), b = evaluate3(expression.right, depth + 1);
        if (expression.op === "add" || expression.op === "subtract") {
          if (unitLabel(a.dimensions) !== unitLabel(b.dimensions)) return fail("addition requires matching units");
          result2 = { value: expression.op === "add" ? a.value + b.value : a.value - b.value, dimensions: a.dimensions };
        } else {
          if (expression.op === "divide" && b.value === 0) return fail("division by zero");
          result2 = { value: expression.op === "multiply" ? a.value * b.value : a.value / b.value, dimensions: combine(a.dimensions, b.dimensions, expression.op === "multiply" ? 1 : -1) };
        }
        break;
      }
      default:
        return fail("unsupported operation");
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(result2.value) || Math.abs(result2.value) > 1e15) return fail("non-finite or excessive result");
    return result2;
  };
  const result = evaluate3(spec.expression, 0);
  return { value: result.value, unit: unitLabel(result.dimensions), assumptions: [...spec.assumptions] };
}

// src/core/model-drafts.ts
var fail2 = (reason2) => {
  throw new Error(`Invalid model draft: ${reason2}`);
};
var MAX_CONTENT = 64e3;
var MAX_NUMBER = 1e9;
function record(value, label2) {
  if (value === null || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return fail2(`${label2} must be an object`);
  return { ...value };
}
function shape(value, label2, required, optional = []) {
  const object = record(value, label2), allowed = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set([...required, ...optional]);
  for (const key of Object.keys(object)) if (!allowed.has(key)) fail2(`${label2} has unknown key ${key}`);
  for (const key of required) if (!Object.hasOwn(object, key)) fail2(`${label2} is missing ${key}`);
  return object;
}
function string(value, label2, max) {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.trim().length === 0 || value.length > max) return fail2(`${label2} must contain 1\u2013${max} characters`);
  if (/[\u0000-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f\u007f]/u.test(value)) return fail2(`${label2} contains control characters`);
  if (/(?:\b(?:https?|ftp|file):\/\/|\b(?:javascript|vbscript|data):|\bwww\.)/iu.test(value)) return fail2(`${label2} must not contain URLs`);
  if (/```|<\/?(?:script|iframe|object)\b|\bon\w+\s*=/iu.test(value)) return fail2(`${label2} must contain descriptions, not executable markup or code blocks`);
  return value;
}
function finite(value, label2) {
  if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value) || Math.abs(value) > MAX_NUMBER) return fail2(`${label2} must be finite and between -${MAX_NUMBER} and ${MAX_NUMBER}`);
  return value;
}
function array(value, label2, min, max) {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length < min || value.length > max) return fail2(`${label2} needs ${min}\u2013${max} items`);
  return value;
}
function name(value, label2) {
  const result = string(value, label2, 32);
  if (!/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,31}$/u.test(result) || ["constructor", "prototype", "__proto__"].includes(result)) return fail2(`${label2} must be a simple variable name`);
  return result;
}
function parseJson(source2) {
  const objects = [];
  let index = 0;
  while (index < source2.length) {
    const char = source2[index];
    if (char === "{" || char === "[") {
      if (objects.length >= 32) return fail2("JSON nesting exceeds bounds");
      objects.push(char === "{" ? /* @__PURE__ */ new Set() : null);
      index++;
      continue;
    }
    if (char === "}" || char === "]") {
      objects.pop();
      index++;
      continue;
    }
    if (char !== '"') {
      index++;
      continue;
    }
    const start = index++;
    while (index < source2.length) {
      if (source2[index] === "\\") {
        index += 2;
        continue;
      }
      if (source2[index++] === '"') break;
    }
    let next = index;
    while (/\s/u.test(source2[next] ?? "") && next < source2.length) next++;
    const object = objects.at(-1);
    if (source2[next] === ":" && object) {
      let key;
      try {
        key = JSON.parse(source2.slice(start, index));
      } catch {
        return fail2("malformed JSON string");
      }
      if (typeof key !== "string") return fail2("malformed JSON key");
      if (object.has(key)) return fail2(`duplicate JSON key ${key}`);
      object.add(key);
    }
  }
  try {
    return JSON.parse(source2);
  } catch {
    return fail2("malformed JSON");
  }
}
function experiment(value) {
  const object = shape(value, "experiment draft", ["schemaVersion", "kind", "title", "explanation", "spec", "inputs"], ["unknownInputs"]);
  const title2 = string(object.title, "title", 200), explanation = string(object.explanation, "explanation", 4e3);
  const source2 = shape(object.spec, "spec", ["title", "expression", "variables", "assumptions"]);
  const specTitle = string(source2.title, "spec.title", 200);
  const variables = array(source2.variables, "variables", 1, 12).map((entry, index) => {
    const variable = shape(entry, `variable ${index + 1}`, ["name", "unit", "min", "max"]);
    const result = { name: name(variable.name, "variable.name"), unit: string(variable.unit, "variable.unit", 80), min: finite(variable.min, "variable.min"), max: finite(variable.max, "variable.max") };
    if (result.min > result.max) return fail2("variable minimum exceeds maximum");
    return result;
  });
  const variableNames = new Set(variables.map((variable) => variable.name));
  if (variableNames.size !== variables.length) return fail2("duplicate variable names");
  const assumptions = array(source2.assumptions, "assumptions", 1, 12).map((entry, index) => string(entry, `assumption ${index + 1}`, 500));
  let nodes = 0;
  const expression = (entry, depth) => {
    if (++nodes > 64 || depth > 12) return fail2("expression exceeds 64 nodes or depth 12");
    const candidate = record(entry, "expression");
    switch (candidate.op) {
      case "constant": {
        const item = shape(candidate, "constant", ["op", "value"], ["unit"]);
        return { op: "constant", value: finite(item.value, "constant.value"), ...item.unit === void 0 ? {} : { unit: string(item.unit, "constant.unit", 80) } };
      }
      case "variable": {
        const item = shape(candidate, "variable expression", ["op", "name"]);
        const variableName = name(item.name, "expression.name");
        if (!variableNames.has(variableName)) return fail2("expression references an unknown variable");
        return { op: "variable", name: variableName };
      }
      case "add":
      case "subtract":
      case "multiply":
      case "divide": {
        const item = shape(candidate, "binary expression", ["op", "left", "right"]);
        return { op: candidate.op, left: expression(item.left, depth + 1), right: expression(item.right, depth + 1) };
      }
      case "power": {
        const item = shape(candidate, "power expression", ["op", "base", "exponent"]);
        const exponent = finite(item.exponent, "exponent");
        if (!Number.isInteger(exponent) || Math.abs(exponent) > 8) return fail2("exponent must be an integer from -8 to 8");
        return { op: "power", base: expression(item.base, depth + 1), exponent };
      }
      default:
        return fail2("unsupported expression operation; only bounded arithmetic data is allowed");
    }
  };
  const spec = { title: specTitle, expression: expression(source2.expression, 0), variables, assumptions };
  const rawInputs = shape(object.inputs, "inputs", [...variableNames]);
  const inputs = Object.fromEntries(variables.map((variable) => [variable.name, finite(rawInputs[variable.name], `input ${variable.name}`)]));
  try {
    evaluateExperiment(spec, inputs);
  } catch (error) {
    return fail2(`experiment evaluation failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : "invalid calculation"}`);
  }
  const unknownInputs = object.unknownInputs === void 0 ? void 0 : array(object.unknownInputs, "unknownInputs", 0, variables.length).map((value2) => name(value2, "unknown input"));
  if (unknownInputs && (new Set(unknownInputs).size !== unknownInputs.length || unknownInputs.some((name2) => !variableNames.has(name2)))) return fail2("unknownInputs must name distinct declared variables");
  return { schemaVersion: 1, kind: "experiment", title: title2, explanation, spec, inputs, ...unknownInputs ? { unknownInputs } : {} };
}
function procedure(value) {
  const object = shape(value, "procedure draft", ["schemaVersion", "kind", "title", "summary", "steps", "limitations"]);
  const title2 = string(object.title, "title", 200), summary = string(object.summary, "summary", 4e3);
  const steps = array(object.steps, "steps", 1, 12).map((entry, index) => {
    const step2 = shape(entry, `step ${index + 1}`, ["intent", "target", "preconditions", "expectedResult"]);
    const preconditions = array(step2.preconditions, `step ${index + 1} preconditions`, 0, 4).map((entry2) => {
      const condition = shape(entry2, "precondition", ["key", "equals"]);
      return { key: string(condition.key, "precondition.key", 100), equals: string(condition.equals, "precondition.equals", 500) };
    });
    if (new Set(preconditions.map((condition) => condition.key)).size !== preconditions.length) return fail2(`step ${index + 1} repeats a precondition key`);
    return { intent: string(step2.intent, "step.intent", 1e3), target: string(step2.target, "step.target", 1e3), preconditions, expectedResult: string(step2.expectedResult, "step.expectedResult", 1e3) };
  });
  const limitations = array(object.limitations, "limitations", 1, 8).map((entry, index) => string(entry, `limitation ${index + 1}`, 500));
  return { schemaVersion: 1, kind: "procedure", title: title2, summary, steps, limitations };
}
function parseModelDraft(content, expectedKind) {
  if (typeof content !== "string" || content.length < 1 || content.length > MAX_CONTENT) return fail2(`response must contain 1\u2013${MAX_CONTENT} characters`);
  if (expectedKind !== void 0 && expectedKind !== "experiment" && expectedKind !== "procedure") return fail2("unsupported expected draft kind");
  let source2 = content.trim();
  if (source2.startsWith("```")) {
    const fenced = /^```json[ \t]*\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n```$/u.exec(source2);
    if (!fenced || fenced[1].includes("```")) return fail2("use raw JSON or exactly one fenced json block");
    source2 = fenced[1];
  }
  const object = record(parseJson(source2), "draft");
  if (object.schemaVersion !== 1) return fail2("unsupported schemaVersion");
  if (object.kind !== "experiment" && object.kind !== "procedure") return fail2("unsupported draft kind");
  if (expectedKind && expectedKind !== object.kind) return fail2(`draft kind does not match expected ${expectedKind}`);
  return object.kind === "experiment" ? experiment(object) : procedure(object);
}

// src/core/source-resume.ts
var sameRef = (a, b) => a.sourceId === b.sourceId && a.version === b.version && a.digest === b.digest;
var excerpt = (text6) => Array.from(text6.replace(/data:image\/[^;]+;base64,[a-z0-9+/=]+/gi, "[historical image excluded]")).slice(0, 1e3).join("");
function sourceResumeContext(task) {
  const allSources = task.sources.flatMap((source2) => {
    const version2 = source2.versions.at(-1);
    if (!version2) return [];
    const ref = { sourceId: source2.id, version: version2.version, digest: version2.digest };
    return [{ ref, label: excerpt(version2.label).slice(0, 200), kind: version2.kind, status: source2.freshness, reason: source2.staleReason ? excerpt(source2.staleReason).slice(0, 300) : version2.kind === "window" ? "A frozen window snapshot is historical evidence, not a live document." : null, authority: version2.kind === "window" ? "new-user-gesture-required" : "saved-reference", documentEvidence: version2.documentStamp?.evidence ?? "unavailable", ...source2.documentChange ? { documentChange: { kind: source2.documentChange.kind, reason: excerpt(source2.documentChange.reason).slice(0, 300), observedAt: source2.documentChange.observedAt } } : {} }];
  });
  const sources = [...allSources.filter((source2) => source2.status === "refresh-required"), ...allSources.filter((source2) => source2.status !== "refresh-required")].slice(0, 32);
  const allAffected = task.artifacts.flatMap((artifact) => {
    const revisions = artifact.revisions.filter((revision5) => revision5.sourceRefs.some((ref) => {
      const source2 = task.sources.find((source3) => source3.id === ref.sourceId), current = source2?.versions.at(-1);
      return !source2 || source2.freshness !== "fresh" || !current || !sameRef(ref, { sourceId: source2.id, version: current.version, digest: current.digest });
    })).map((revision5) => revision5.revision);
    return revisions.length ? [{ artifactId: artifact.id, revisions }] : [];
  });
  const affectedArtifacts = allAffected.slice(0, 32).map((artifact) => ({ ...artifact, revisions: artifact.revisions.slice(-16), ...artifact.revisions.length > 16 ? { omittedRevisions: artifact.revisions.length - 16 } : {} }));
  const related = task.checkpoints.filter((checkpoint) => checkpoint.sourceRefs.some((ref) => {
    const source2 = task.sources.find((source3) => source3.id === ref.sourceId), current = source2?.versions.at(-1);
    return !source2 || source2.freshness !== "fresh" || !current || !sameRef(ref, { sourceId: source2.id, version: current.version, digest: current.digest });
  }));
  const included = related.length > 6 ? [...related.slice(0, 2), ...related.slice(-4)] : related;
  return { goal: task.goal, sources, affectedArtifacts, omissions: { sources: allSources.length - sources.length, affectedArtifacts: allAffected.length - affectedArtifacts.length }, relatedCheckpoints: included.map((checkpoint) => ({ id: checkpoint.id, note: excerpt(checkpoint.note), createdAt: checkpoint.createdAt, sourceRefs: checkpoint.sourceRefs })), omittedRelatedCheckpoints: related.length - included.length, authority: "Saved observations and decisions provide historical context. They do not authorize capture, execution, transmission or replay." };
}

// src/core/interactive-modules.ts
import { Schema as Schema10 } from "effect";

// src/learning/join-lab.ts
import { Schema as Schema5 } from "effect";
var limits = Object.freeze({ rowsPerTable: 12, columnsPerTable: 4, outputRows: 144, revisions: 500 });
var id2 = Schema5.String.pipe(Schema5.pattern(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$/));
var text2 = Schema5.String.pipe(Schema5.minLength(1), Schema5.maxLength(160));
var integer = Schema5.Number.pipe(Schema5.filter(Number.isSafeInteger));
var revision = integer.pipe(Schema5.between(0, limits.revisions));
var cell = Schema5.Union(Schema5.Null, Schema5.String.pipe(Schema5.maxLength(160)), integer, Schema5.Boolean);
var column = Schema5.Struct({ id: id2, label: text2, type: Schema5.Literal("string", "integer", "boolean") });
var row = Schema5.Struct({ id: id2, values: Schema5.Array(cell).pipe(Schema5.minItems(1), Schema5.maxItems(limits.columnsPerTable)) });
var table = Schema5.Struct({
  id: id2,
  title: text2,
  columns: Schema5.Array(column).pipe(Schema5.minItems(1), Schema5.maxItems(limits.columnsPerTable)),
  rows: Schema5.Array(row).pipe(Schema5.maxItems(limits.rowsPerTable))
});
var join2 = Schema5.Struct({ mode: Schema5.Literal("INNER", "LEFT"), leftColumnId: id2, rightColumnId: id2 });
var joinCase = Schema5.Struct({ id: id2, title: text2, left: table, right: table, join: join2 });
var source = Schema5.Struct({ sourceId: id2, version: integer.pipe(Schema5.positive()), digest: text2 });
var prediction = Schema5.Struct({
  count: integer.pipe(Schema5.between(0, limits.outputRows)),
  reasoning: Schema5.String.pipe(Schema5.maxLength(800))
});
var deterministicOrigin = "deterministic";
var JoinLessonSchema = Schema5.Struct({
  kind: Schema5.Literal("join-lab"),
  schemaVersion: Schema5.Literal(1),
  id: id2,
  version: integer.pipe(Schema5.positive()),
  title: text2,
  source,
  practice: joinCase,
  transfer: joinCase
});
var JoinStateSchema = Schema5.Struct({
  kind: Schema5.Literal("join-lab"),
  revision,
  lessonId: id2,
  lessonVersion: integer.pipe(Schema5.positive()),
  source,
  practice: joinCase,
  practiceEdits: revision,
  undoPractice: Schema5.optional(joinCase),
  phase: Schema5.Union(
    Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("practice-predict") }),
    Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("practice-reviewed"), prediction }),
    Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("transfer-predict"), practicePrediction: prediction }),
    Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("transfer-reviewed"), practicePrediction: prediction, prediction })
  )
});
var JoinActionSchema = Schema5.Union(
  Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("edit-row"), side: Schema5.Literal("left", "right"), rowId: id2, values: row.fields.values, expectedRevision: revision }),
  Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("set-keys"), leftColumnId: id2, rightColumnId: id2, expectedRevision: revision }),
  Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("set-mode"), mode: Schema5.Literal("INNER", "LEFT"), expectedRevision: revision }),
  Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("predict"), ...prediction.fields, expectedRevision: revision }),
  Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("start-transfer"), expectedRevision: revision }),
  Schema5.Struct({ kind: Schema5.Literal("undo-practice"), expectedRevision: revision })
);
function decode(schema, value) {
  return Schema5.decodeUnknownSync(schema, { onExcessProperty: "error" })(value);
}
function unique(ids) {
  if (new Set(ids).size !== ids.length) throw Error("Every lesson case, table, column and row needs a unique identity.");
}
function keyIndex(input2, side) {
  return input2[side].columns.findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === (side === "left" ? input2.join.leftColumnId : input2.join.rightColumnId));
}
function validateJoinCase(input2) {
  for (const current of [input2.left, input2.right]) {
    unique([current.id, ...current.columns.map((value) => value.id), ...current.rows.map((value) => value.id)]);
    for (const currentRow of current.rows) {
      if (currentRow.values.length !== current.columns.length) throw Error("Every row must have exactly one value per column.");
      current.columns.forEach((currentColumn, index) => {
        const value = currentRow.values[index];
        if (value === null) return;
        const valid = currentColumn.type === "integer" ? typeof value === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(value) : typeof value === currentColumn.type;
        if (!valid) throw Error(`Cell ${currentRow.id}/${currentColumn.id} must be ${currentColumn.type} or NULL. No coercion is performed.`);
      });
    }
  }
  const leftKey = input2.left.columns[keyIndex(input2, "left")];
  const rightKey = input2.right.columns[keyIndex(input2, "right")];
  if (!leftKey || !rightKey) throw Error("Join keys must identify existing columns on the correct side.");
  if (leftKey.type !== rightKey.type) throw Error("Join keys must have the same declared type. No coercion is performed.");
}
function sameValue(left, right) {
  return left !== null && right !== null && left === right;
}
function matchingStructure(input2) {
  const leftIndex = keyIndex(input2, "left"), rightIndex = keyIndex(input2, "right");
  return JSON.stringify({
    mode: input2.join.mode,
    leftNulls: input2.left.rows.map((value) => value.values[leftIndex] === null),
    rightNulls: input2.right.rows.map((value) => value.values[rightIndex] === null),
    matches: input2.left.rows.map((left) => input2.right.rows.map((right) => sameValue(left.values[leftIndex], right.values[rightIndex])))
  });
}
function validateLesson(data) {
  const cases = [data.practice, data.transfer];
  unique([data.id, ...cases.flatMap((input2) => [input2.id, ...[input2.left, input2.right].flatMap((current) => [current.id, ...current.columns.map((value) => value.id), ...current.rows.map((value) => value.id)])])]);
  cases.forEach(validateJoinCase);
  if (matchingStructure(data.practice) === matchingStructure(data.transfer)) throw Error("The held-out transfer must differ in join mode or matching structure.");
}
function parse(value) {
  const data = decode(JoinLessonSchema, value);
  validateLesson(data);
  return data;
}
function tableIdentity(input2) {
  return { id: input2.id, title: input2.title, columns: input2.columns.map((value) => [value.id, value.label, value.type]), rowIds: input2.rows.map((value) => value.id) };
}
function parseState(data, value) {
  const state = decode(JoinStateSchema, value);
  if (state.lessonId !== data.id || state.lessonVersion !== data.version || state.source.sourceId !== data.source.sourceId || state.source.version !== data.source.version || state.source.digest !== data.source.digest) throw Error("Saved state belongs to another lesson version or source.");
  if (state.practice.id !== data.practice.id || state.practice.title !== data.practice.title || ["left", "right"].some((side) => {
    const current = side === "left" ? state.practice.left : state.practice.right;
    const original = side === "left" ? data.practice.left : data.practice.right;
    return JSON.stringify(tableIdentity(current)) !== JSON.stringify(tableIdentity(original));
  })) throw Error("Saved state cannot replace lesson identities or columns.");
  validateJoinCase(state.practice);
  if (state.undoPractice) {
    const previous = state.undoPractice;
    validateJoinCase(previous);
    if (previous.id !== data.practice.id || previous.title !== data.practice.title || ["left", "right"].some((side) => JSON.stringify(tableIdentity(side === "left" ? previous.left : previous.right)) !== JSON.stringify(tableIdentity(side === "left" ? data.practice.left : data.practice.right)))) throw Error("Undo cannot replace lesson identities.");
  }
  if (state.practiceEdits > state.revision) throw Error("Saved edit count exceeds its revision.");
  if (state.practiceEdits === 0 && JSON.stringify(state.practice) !== JSON.stringify(data.practice)) throw Error("Changed practice values require a recorded edit.");
  const minimumStageSteps = { "practice-predict": 0, "practice-reviewed": 1, "transfer-predict": 2, "transfer-reviewed": 3 };
  if (state.revision < state.practiceEdits + minimumStageSteps[state.phase.kind]) throw Error("Saved lesson stage exceeds its revision.");
  if ((state.phase.kind === "transfer-predict" || state.phase.kind === "transfer-reviewed") && state.practiceEdits === 0) throw Error("Transfer requires an edited practice example.");
  if ((state.phase.kind === "transfer-predict" || state.phase.kind === "transfer-reviewed") && (matchingStructure(state.practice) === matchingStructure(data.practice) || matchingStructure(state.practice) === matchingStructure(data.transfer))) throw Error("Transfer requires a changed relationship and a distinct challenge.");
  return state;
}
function initial(value) {
  const data = parse(value);
  return { kind: "join-lab", revision: 0, lessonId: data.id, lessonVersion: data.version, source: data.source, practice: data.practice, practiceEdits: 0, phase: { kind: "practice-predict" } };
}
function evaluate(input2) {
  const rows = [], contributions = [];
  const leftIndex = keyIndex(input2, "left"), rightIndex = keyIndex(input2, "right");
  for (const left of input2.left.rows) {
    const key = left.values[leftIndex];
    const matches = input2.right.rows.filter((right) => sameValue(key, right.values[rightIndex]));
    for (const right of matches) rows.push({
      id: `${left.id}:${right.id}`,
      kind: "matched",
      provenance: { leftTableId: input2.left.id, leftRowId: left.id, rightTableId: input2.right.id, rightRowId: right.id },
      leftValues: left.values,
      rightValues: right.values
    });
    if (matches.length === 0 && input2.join.mode === "LEFT") rows.push({
      id: `${left.id}:@unmatched`,
      kind: "left-unmatched",
      provenance: { leftTableId: input2.left.id, leftRowId: left.id, rightTableId: input2.right.id, rightRowId: null },
      leftValues: left.values,
      rightValues: input2.right.columns.map(() => null)
    });
    contributions.push({ leftRowId: left.id, key, matchingRightRowIds: matches.map((right) => right.id), outputCount: matches.length || (input2.join.mode === "LEFT" ? 1 : 0), reason: key === null ? "null-key" : matches.length ? "matches" : "no-match" });
  }
  return { origin: "deterministic", caseId: input2.id, rowCount: rows.length, rows, contributions };
}
function assess(observation, guess, mode2) {
  const details = observation.contributions.map((value) => {
    if (value.reason === "matches") return `${value.leftRowId} matches ${value.matchingRightRowIds.join(", ")} and contributes ${value.outputCount} row(s).`;
    const reason2 = value.reason === "null-key" ? "has a NULL key; equality is unknown even against NULL" : "has no equal non-NULL right key";
    return `${value.leftRowId} ${reason2}, contributing ${value.outputCount}${mode2 === "LEFT" ? " null-extended row(s)" : " rows under INNER"}.`;
  });
  return {
    origin: deterministicOrigin,
    predictedCount: guess.count,
    actualCount: observation.rowCount,
    correct: guess.count === observation.rowCount,
    difference: observation.rowCount - guess.count,
    reasoning: guess.reasoning,
    correction: `${guess.count === observation.rowCount ? "Correct." : `You predicted ${guess.count}; the actual count is ${observation.rowCount}.`} ${details.join(" ")} Each equal pair is kept; duplicate keys are not deduplicated. Right-side NULL keys never satisfy equality.`
  };
}
function update(dataValue, stateValue, actionValue) {
  const data = parse(dataValue), state = parseState(data, stateValue), action = decode(JoinActionSchema, actionValue);
  if (action.expectedRevision !== state.revision) throw Error("This lesson changed. Reload its current state before applying this action.");
  if (state.revision === limits.revisions) throw Error("This lesson reached its revision limit. Create a new module version.");
  if (action.kind === "predict" && state.phase.kind === "practice-predict") return {
    ...state,
    revision: state.revision + 1,
    phase: { kind: "practice-reviewed", prediction: { count: action.count, reasoning: action.reasoning } }
  };
  if (action.kind === "predict" && state.phase.kind === "transfer-predict") return {
    ...state,
    revision: state.revision + 1,
    phase: { kind: "transfer-reviewed", practicePrediction: state.phase.practicePrediction, prediction: { count: action.count, reasoning: action.reasoning } }
  };
  if (action.kind === "start-transfer" && state.phase.kind === "practice-reviewed" && state.practiceEdits > 0) {
    if (matchingStructure(data.practice) === matchingStructure(state.practice)) throw Error("Change a join relationship, then predict and inspect its result before transfer.");
    if (matchingStructure(data.transfer) === matchingStructure(state.practice)) throw Error("This challenge now matches your practice relationship. Start a new lesson with a distinct challenge.");
    return { ...state, revision: state.revision + 1, phase: { kind: "transfer-predict", practicePrediction: state.phase.prediction } };
  }
  if (action.kind === "undo-practice" && state.undoPractice && (state.phase.kind === "practice-predict" || state.phase.kind === "practice-reviewed")) {
    const { undoPractice, ...previous } = state;
    return { ...previous, revision: state.revision + 1, practiceEdits: state.practiceEdits + 1, practice: undoPractice, phase: { kind: "practice-predict" } };
  }
  if (action.kind === "edit-row" || action.kind === "set-keys" || action.kind === "set-mode") {
    if (state.phase.kind !== "practice-predict" && state.phase.kind !== "practice-reviewed") throw Error("The held-out transfer cannot be edited.");
    let practice;
    if (action.kind === "edit-row") {
      const current = state.practice[action.side];
      if (!current.rows.some((value) => value.id === action.rowId)) throw Error("The row is not on the selected side.");
      const replacement = { ...current, rows: current.rows.map((value) => value.id === action.rowId ? { ...value, values: action.values } : value) };
      practice = { ...state.practice, [action.side]: replacement };
    } else if (action.kind === "set-keys") {
      practice = { ...state.practice, join: { ...state.practice.join, leftColumnId: action.leftColumnId, rightColumnId: action.rightColumnId } };
    } else {
      practice = { ...state.practice, join: { ...state.practice.join, mode: action.mode } };
    }
    validateJoinCase(practice);
    if (JSON.stringify(practice) === JSON.stringify(state.practice)) throw Error("Choose a change that alters the example.");
    return { ...state, revision: state.revision + 1, practiceEdits: state.practiceEdits + 1, undoPractice: state.practice, practice, phase: { kind: "practice-predict" } };
  }
  throw Error("This action is not available at the current lesson stage.");
}
function observe(dataValue, stateValue) {
  const data = parse(dataValue), state = parseState(data, stateValue);
  const inTransfer = state.phase.kind === "transfer-predict" || state.phase.kind === "transfer-reviewed";
  const problem = inTransfer ? data.transfer : state.practice;
  const guess = state.phase.kind === "practice-reviewed" || state.phase.kind === "transfer-reviewed" ? state.phase.prediction : null;
  const observation = guess ? evaluate(problem) : null;
  const practiceObservation = inTransfer ? evaluate(state.practice) : null;
  return {
    origin: deterministicOrigin,
    revision: state.revision,
    source: data.source,
    phase: state.phase.kind,
    problem,
    observation,
    assessment: observation && guess ? assess(observation, guess, problem.join.mode) : null,
    change: observation && !inTransfer ? changedResult(data.practice, observation) : null,
    practiceReview: practiceObservation && (state.phase.kind === "transfer-predict" || state.phase.kind === "transfer-reviewed") ? {
      observation: practiceObservation,
      assessment: assess(practiceObservation, state.phase.practicePrediction, state.practice.join.mode),
      change: changedResult(data.practice, practiceObservation)
    } : null
  };
}
function changedResult(original, current) {
  const before = evaluate(original);
  return {
    originalCount: before.rowCount,
    currentCount: current.rowCount,
    addedPairIds: current.rows.filter((value) => !before.rows.some((previous) => previous.id === value.id)).map((value) => value.id),
    removedPairIds: before.rows.filter((value) => !current.rows.some((next) => next.id === value.id)).map((value) => value.id),
    changedPairIds: current.rows.filter((value) => before.rows.some((previous) => previous.id === value.id && JSON.stringify(previous) !== JSON.stringify(value))).map((value) => value.id)
  };
}
function readable(dataValue, stateValue) {
  const data = parse(dataValue), state = stateValue === void 0 ? initial(data) : parseState(data, stateValue);
  const view = observe(data, state);
  const tables = [view.problem.left, view.problem.right].map((current) => `${current.title} (${current.id})
Columns: ${current.columns.map((value) => `${value.id} ${value.label} (${value.type})`).join(", ")}
${current.rows.map((value) => `${value.id}: ${JSON.stringify(value.values)}`).join("\n") || "(empty)"}`).join("\n\n");
  const pairs = view.observation ? `
Paired row identities (${view.observation.rowCount}):
${view.observation.rows.map((value) => `${value.id} (${value.kind})`).join("\n") || "(none)"}` : "";
  const delta = view.change ?? view.practiceReview?.change;
  const change = delta ? `
Original count: ${delta.originalCount}; current count: ${delta.currentCount}. Added pairs: ${delta.addedPairIds.join(", ") || "(none)"}. Removed pairs: ${delta.removedPairIds.join(", ") || "(none)"}. Changed pair values: ${delta.changedPairIds.join(", ") || "(none)"}.` : "";
  const practiceReview = view.practiceReview ? `
Practice correction: ${view.practiceReview.assessment.correction}
Recorded practice reasoning (ungraded input): ${JSON.stringify(view.practiceReview.assessment.reasoning)}` : "";
  const reasoning = view.assessment ? `
Recorded reasoning (ungraded input): ${JSON.stringify(view.assessment.reasoning)}` : "";
  return `${data.title}
${view.problem.title}
Source: ${data.source.sourceId} version ${data.source.version}; digest ${data.source.digest}
Observation revision: ${state.revision}
${view.problem.join.mode} equality join on ${view.problem.join.leftColumnId} = ${view.problem.join.rightColumnId}.

${tables}

${view.assessment?.correction ?? "Predict the result count to reveal paired rows."}${reasoning}${pairs}${practiceReview}${change}
NULL never matches under ordinary equality. Duplicate matches each produce a row. Types must agree; no coercion. Count correctness is checked; reasoning and human learning are not evaluated.`;
}
var joinLab = Object.freeze({
  kind: "join-lab",
  schemaVersion: 1,
  parse,
  parseAction: (value) => decode(JoinActionSchema, value),
  parseState: (dataValue, value) => parseState(parse(dataValue), value),
  initial,
  update,
  observe,
  text: readable
});

// src/learning/reusable-helper.ts
import { Schema as Schema6 } from "effect";
var id3 = Schema6.String.pipe(Schema6.pattern(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$/));
var short = Schema6.String.pipe(Schema6.minLength(1), Schema6.maxLength(160));
var input = Schema6.String.pipe(Schema6.maxLength(4e3));
var output = Schema6.String.pipe(Schema6.maxLength(16e3));
var rev = Schema6.Int.pipe(Schema6.between(0, 500));
var HelperOperationSchema = Schema6.Union(
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("trim", "collapse-spaces", "lowercase", "uppercase") }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("replace-literal"), find: Schema6.String.pipe(Schema6.minLength(1), Schema6.maxLength(80)), replacement: Schema6.String.pipe(Schema6.maxLength(80)) })
);
var exception = Schema6.Struct({ id: id3, contains: Schema6.String.pipe(Schema6.minLength(1), Schema6.maxLength(80)), behavior: Schema6.Literal("preserve", "abstain"), reason: short });
var expected = Schema6.Union(Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("output"), text: output }), Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("abstain") }));
var step = Schema6.Struct({ operation: HelperOperationSchema, before: output, after: output });
var runResult = Schema6.Union(Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("output"), text: output, exceptionId: Schema6.NullOr(id3), trace: Schema6.Array(step).pipe(Schema6.maxItems(8)) }), Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("abstain"), reason: short, exceptionId: id3, trace: Schema6.Array(step).pipe(Schema6.maxItems(8)) }));
var testCase = Schema6.Struct({ id: id3, label: short, role: Schema6.Literal("example", "counterexample"), input, expected, demonstration: Schema6.optional(Schema6.Array(step).pipe(Schema6.minItems(1), Schema6.maxItems(8))) });
var definition = Schema6.Struct({ name: short, description: short, invocation: short, operations: Schema6.Array(HelperOperationSchema).pipe(Schema6.maxItems(8)), exceptions: Schema6.Array(exception).pipe(Schema6.maxItems(8)), tests: Schema6.Array(testCase).pipe(Schema6.maxItems(20)) });
var version = Schema6.Struct({ version: Schema6.Int.pipe(Schema6.between(1, 20)), savedAtRevision: rev, changeNote: short, definition });
var HelperDataSchema = Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("helper-studio"), schemaVersion: Schema6.Literal(1), id: id3, title: short, description: short });
var HelperStateSchema = Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("helper-studio"), helperId: id3, revision: rev, draft: definition, versions: Schema6.Array(version).pipe(Schema6.maxItems(20)), activeVersion: Schema6.NullOr(Schema6.Int.pipe(Schema6.between(1, 20))), recording: Schema6.NullOr(Schema6.Struct({ input, current: output, steps: Schema6.Array(step).pipe(Schema6.maxItems(8)) })), lastRun: Schema6.optional(Schema6.NullOr(Schema6.Struct({ version: Schema6.Int.pipe(Schema6.between(1, 20)), input, result: runResult }))) });
var HelperActionSchema = Schema6.Union(
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("start-demonstration"), input, expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("demonstrate-step"), operation: HelperOperationSchema, expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("finish-demonstration", "cancel-demonstration", "clear-operations"), expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("append-operation"), operation: HelperOperationSchema, expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("set-details"), name: short, description: short, invocation: short, expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("add-exception"), exception, expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("remove-exception"), id: id3, expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("add-test"), test: testCase, expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("remove-test"), id: id3, expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("save-version"), changeNote: short, expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("activate-version", "restore-version"), version: Schema6.Int.pipe(Schema6.between(1, 20)), expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("deactivate"), expectedRevision: rev }),
  Schema6.Struct({ kind: Schema6.Literal("run-active"), input, expectedRevision: rev })
);
function decode2(schema, value) {
  return Schema6.decodeUnknownSync(schema, { onExcessProperty: "error" })(value);
}
function operation(value, op) {
  let result;
  switch (op.kind) {
    case "trim":
      result = value.trim();
      break;
    case "collapse-spaces":
      result = value.replace(/[ \t]+/g, " ");
      break;
    case "lowercase":
      result = value.toLowerCase();
      break;
    case "uppercase":
      result = value.toUpperCase();
      break;
    case "replace-literal":
      result = value.split(op.find).join(op.replacement);
      break;
  }
  if (result.length > 16e3) throw Error("The output exceeds the local text limit.");
  return result;
}
function execute(data, value) {
  const special = data.exceptions.find((rule2) => value.includes(rule2.contains));
  if (special?.behavior === "abstain") return { kind: "abstain", reason: special.reason, exceptionId: special.id, trace: [] };
  if (special) return { kind: "output", text: value, exceptionId: special.id, trace: [] };
  const trace = [];
  let text6 = value;
  for (const op of data.operations) {
    const before = text6;
    text6 = operation(text6, op);
    trace.push({ operation: op, before, after: text6 });
  }
  return { kind: "output", text: text6, exceptionId: null, trace };
}
function unique2(values) {
  if (new Set(values).size !== values.length) throw Error("Test and exception identities must be unique.");
}
function validateDefinition(data) {
  unique2(data.tests.map((t) => t.id));
  unique2(data.exceptions.map((t) => t.id));
  unique2(data.exceptions.map((t) => t.contains));
  for (const test of data.tests) {
    if (!test.demonstration) continue;
    let current = test.input;
    for (const event of test.demonstration) {
      if (event.before !== current || operation(current, event.operation) !== event.after) throw Error("The demonstration action/result trace is inconsistent.");
      current = event.after;
    }
  }
}
function checkHelper(value) {
  const data = decode2(definition, value);
  validateDefinition(data);
  const cases = data.tests.map((test) => {
    try {
      const actual = execute(data, test.input);
      const passed = actual.kind === test.expected.kind && (actual.kind !== "output" || test.expected.kind !== "output" || actual.text === test.expected.text);
      return { id: test.id, label: test.label, role: test.role, passed, expected: test.expected, actual, error: null };
    } catch (cause) {
      return { id: test.id, label: test.label, role: test.role, passed: false, expected: test.expected, actual: null, error: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Could not execute this test." };
    }
  });
  const exampleInputs = new Set(data.tests.filter((t) => t.role === "example").map((t) => t.input));
  const coverageIssues = [];
  if (data.operations.length === 0) coverageIssues.push("Add at least one transformation.");
  if (exampleInputs.size === 0) coverageIssues.push("Add an example.");
  if (!data.tests.some((t) => t.role === "counterexample" && !exampleInputs.has(t.input))) coverageIssues.push("Add a counterexample with different input.");
  for (const rule2 of data.exceptions) if (!cases.some((c) => c.actual?.exceptionId === rule2.id)) coverageIssues.push(`Exercise exception ${rule2.id} in a check.`);
  const covered = coverageIssues.length === 0;
  return { passed: covered && cases.every((c) => c.passed), covered, coverageIssues, cases };
}
function parseState2(dataValue, value) {
  const data = decode2(HelperDataSchema, dataValue), state = decode2(HelperStateSchema, value);
  if (state.helperId !== data.id) throw Error("This helper state belongs to a different helper.");
  validateDefinition(state.draft);
  state.versions.forEach((v, index) => {
    validateDefinition(v.definition);
    if (v.version !== index + 1 || v.savedAtRevision > state.revision || !checkHelper(v.definition).passed) throw Error("Saved helper versions must be ordered, tested immutable snapshots.");
  });
  if (state.activeVersion !== null && !state.versions.some((v) => v.version === state.activeVersion)) throw Error("The active helper version is unavailable.");
  if (state.lastRun) {
    const run = state.lastRun, saved = state.versions.find((v) => v.version === run.version);
    if (!saved || JSON.stringify(execute(saved.definition, run.input)) !== JSON.stringify(run.result)) throw Error("Saved helper output does not match its exact input and version.");
  }
  if (state.recording) {
    let current = state.recording.input;
    for (const event of state.recording.steps) {
      if (event.before !== current || operation(current, event.operation) !== event.after) throw Error("Invalid recording trace.");
      current = event.after;
    }
    if (current !== state.recording.current) throw Error("Recording output does not match its actions.");
  }
  return state;
}
function initial2(dataValue) {
  const data = decode2(HelperDataSchema, dataValue);
  return { kind: "helper-studio", helperId: data.id, revision: 0, draft: { name: data.title, description: data.description, invocation: "Clean this pasted label", operations: [], exceptions: [], tests: [] }, versions: [], activeVersion: null, recording: null };
}
function update2(dataValue, stateValue, actionValue) {
  const state = parseState2(dataValue, stateValue), action = decode2(HelperActionSchema, actionValue);
  if (action.expectedRevision !== state.revision) throw Error("This helper changed. Reload it before applying the correction.");
  if (state.revision >= 500) throw Error("The helper reached its local revision limit.");
  let next = { ...state, revision: state.revision + 1, lastRun: null };
  if (action.kind === "start-demonstration") {
    if (state.recording) throw Error("Finish or cancel the current demonstration first.");
    next = { ...next, recording: { input: action.input, current: action.input, steps: [] } };
  } else if (action.kind === "demonstrate-step") {
    if (!state.recording) throw Error("Start an explicit demonstration first.");
    const after = operation(state.recording.current, action.operation);
    next = { ...next, recording: { ...state.recording, current: after, steps: [...state.recording.steps, { operation: action.operation, before: state.recording.current, after }] } };
  } else if (action.kind === "finish-demonstration") {
    if (!state.recording?.steps.length) throw Error("Demonstrate at least one transformation.");
    next = { ...next, recording: null, draft: { ...state.draft, operations: state.recording.steps.map((event) => event.operation), tests: [...state.draft.tests, { id: `demo-${state.revision}`, label: "Recorded local demonstration", role: "example", input: state.recording.input, expected: { kind: "output", text: state.recording.current }, demonstration: state.recording.steps }] } };
  } else if (action.kind === "cancel-demonstration") next = { ...next, recording: null };
  else {
    if (state.recording) throw Error("Finish or cancel the demonstration before changing this helper.");
    switch (action.kind) {
      case "append-operation":
        next = { ...next, draft: { ...state.draft, operations: [...state.draft.operations, action.operation] } };
        break;
      case "clear-operations":
        next = { ...next, draft: { ...state.draft, operations: [] } };
        break;
      case "set-details":
        next = { ...next, draft: { ...state.draft, name: action.name, description: action.description, invocation: action.invocation } };
        break;
      case "add-exception":
        next = { ...next, draft: { ...state.draft, exceptions: [...state.draft.exceptions, action.exception] } };
        break;
      case "remove-exception":
        next = { ...next, draft: { ...state.draft, exceptions: state.draft.exceptions.filter((value) => value.id !== action.id) } };
        break;
      case "add-test":
        next = { ...next, draft: { ...state.draft, tests: [...state.draft.tests.filter((t) => t.id !== action.test.id), action.test] } };
        break;
      case "remove-test":
        next = { ...next, draft: { ...state.draft, tests: state.draft.tests.filter((t) => t.id !== action.id) } };
        break;
      case "save-version": {
        if (!checkHelper(state.draft).passed) throw Error("Pass the example and counterexample tests before saving a version.");
        next = { ...next, versions: [...state.versions, { version: state.versions.length + 1, savedAtRevision: next.revision, changeNote: action.changeNote, definition: state.draft }] };
        break;
      }
      case "activate-version":
      case "restore-version": {
        const saved = state.versions.find((v) => v.version === action.version);
        if (!saved) throw Error("That saved version is unavailable.");
        next = action.kind === "activate-version" ? { ...next, activeVersion: saved.version } : { ...next, draft: saved.definition };
        break;
      }
      case "deactivate":
        next = { ...next, activeVersion: null };
        break;
      case "run-active": {
        const saved = state.versions.find((v) => v.version === state.activeVersion);
        if (!saved) throw Error("Activate a saved version before running this helper.");
        next = { ...next, lastRun: { version: saved.version, input: action.input, result: execute(saved.definition, action.input) } };
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return parseState2(dataValue, next);
}
var helperStudio = Object.freeze({ kind: "helper-studio", schemaVersion: 1, parse: (value) => decode2(HelperDataSchema, value), parseState: parseState2, parseAction: (value) => decode2(HelperActionSchema, value), initial: initial2, update: update2, text: (dataValue, stateValue) => {
  const data = decode2(HelperDataSchema, dataValue), state = stateValue === void 0 ? initial2(data) : parseState2(data, stateValue);
  const run = state.lastRun;
  const observation = run ? `
Last run used version ${run.version}.
Input: ${JSON.stringify(run.input)}
${run.result.kind === "output" ? `Result: ${JSON.stringify(run.result.text)}` : `Abstained: ${run.result.reason}`}
${run.result.exceptionId ? `Applied exception: ${state.versions.find((v) => v.version === run.version)?.definition.exceptions.find((rule2) => rule2.id === run.result.exceptionId)?.reason ?? "Saved exception"}.` : "No exception matched."}` : "";
  return `${state.draft.name}
${state.draft.description}
Say: ${state.draft.invocation}
Scope: text provided in this helper.
Active version: ${state.activeVersion ?? "none"}. Saved versions: ${state.versions.map((v) => `${v.version}: ${v.changeNote}`).join("; ") || "none"}.${observation}
Draft tests: ${checkHelper(state.draft).passed ? "passed" : "not passed"}.
${JSON.stringify(state.draft, null, 2)}`;
} });

// src/learning/grounded-join.ts
import { Schema as Schema7 } from "effect";
var id4 = Schema7.String.pipe(Schema7.pattern(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$/));
var text3 = Schema7.String.pipe(Schema7.minLength(1), Schema7.maxLength(500));
var title = Schema7.String.pipe(Schema7.minLength(1), Schema7.maxLength(160));
var hostText = Schema7.String.pipe(Schema7.minLength(1), Schema7.maxLength(200));
var digest2 = Schema7.String.pipe(Schema7.minLength(1), Schema7.maxLength(128));
var positive = Schema7.Number.pipe(Schema7.filter(Number.isSafeInteger), Schema7.positive());
var revision2 = Schema7.Int.pipe(Schema7.between(0, 500));
var cell2 = Schema7.Union(Schema7.Null, Schema7.String.pipe(Schema7.maxLength(160)), Schema7.Number.pipe(Schema7.filter(Number.isSafeInteger)), Schema7.Boolean);
var GroundingSourceRefSchema = Schema7.Struct({ sourceId: hostText, version: positive, digest: digest2 });
var GroundingArtifactRefSchema = Schema7.Struct({ artifactId: hostText, revision: positive, digest: digest2 });
var location = Schema7.Union(
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("text-range"), start: Schema7.Int.pipe(Schema7.nonNegative()), end: Schema7.Int.pipe(Schema7.positive()), quote: Schema7.String.pipe(Schema7.maxLength(500)) }),
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("image-region"), x: Schema7.Number.pipe(Schema7.between(0, 1)), y: Schema7.Number.pipe(Schema7.between(0, 1)), width: Schema7.Number.pipe(Schema7.greaterThan(0), Schema7.lessThanOrEqualTo(1)), height: Schema7.Number.pipe(Schema7.greaterThan(0), Schema7.lessThanOrEqualTo(1)), quote: Schema7.String.pipe(Schema7.maxLength(500)) })
);
var citation = Schema7.Struct({ id: id4, sourceRef: GroundingSourceRefSchema, location });
var proposedCitation = Schema7.Struct({ id: id4, source: Schema7.String.pipe(Schema7.pattern(/^S[12]$/)), location });
var extractedCell = Schema7.Union(
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("observed"), value: cell2, citationId: id4 }),
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("needs-correction"), reason: text3, citationId: id4 }),
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("provided"), value: cell2 })
);
var extractedColumn = Schema7.Struct({ id: id4, label: title, sourceLabel: title, type: Schema7.Literal("string", "integer", "boolean", "unknown"), citationId: Schema7.NullOr(id4), typeCitationId: Schema7.NullOr(id4) });
var extractedTable = Schema7.Struct({ id: id4, title, citationId: Schema7.NullOr(id4), columns: Schema7.Array(extractedColumn).pipe(Schema7.minItems(1), Schema7.maxItems(4)), rows: Schema7.Array(Schema7.Struct({ id: id4, cells: Schema7.Array(extractedCell).pipe(Schema7.minItems(1), Schema7.maxItems(4)) })).pipe(Schema7.maxItems(12)) });
var keys = Schema7.Struct({ mode: Schema7.Literal("INNER", "LEFT"), leftColumnId: id4, rightColumnId: id4 });
var keyProposal = Schema7.Union(Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("mapped"), keys, reason: text3, citationId: Schema7.NullOr(id4) }), Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("ambiguous"), reason: text3 }));
var extraction = Schema7.Struct({ id: id4, title, left: extractedTable, right: extractedTable, join: keyProposal, assumptions: Schema7.Array(text3).pipe(Schema7.maxItems(8)) });
var JoinExtractionProposalSchema = Schema7.Struct({ schemaVersion: Schema7.Literal(1), extraction, citations: Schema7.Array(proposedCitation).pipe(Schema7.minItems(1), Schema7.maxItems(128)) });
var basis = Schema7.Union(
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("local-demo"), contextDigest: digest2 }),
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("observed-source"), contextDigest: digest2, taskId: hostText, artifact: GroundingArtifactRefSchema, sourceRefs: Schema7.Array(GroundingSourceRefSchema).pipe(Schema7.minItems(1), Schema7.maxItems(2)) })
);
var GroundedJoinDataSchema = Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("grounded-join"), schemaVersion: Schema7.Literal(1), id: id4, title, version: positive, basis, extraction, citations: Schema7.Array(citation).pipe(Schema7.maxItems(128)), transfer: JoinLessonSchema.fields.transfer });
var cellCorrection = Schema7.Struct({ side: Schema7.Literal("left", "right"), rowId: id4, columnId: id4, value: cell2, reason: text3 });
var typeCorrection = Schema7.Struct({ side: Schema7.Literal("left", "right"), columnId: id4, type: Schema7.Literal("string", "integer", "boolean"), reason: text3 });
var GroundedJoinStateSchema = Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("grounded-join"), revision: revision2, contextDigest: digest2, mode: Schema7.Literal("quick", "deep", "visual"), cellCorrections: Schema7.Array(cellCorrection).pipe(Schema7.maxItems(96)), typeCorrections: Schema7.Array(typeCorrection).pipe(Schema7.maxItems(8)), keyCorrection: Schema7.NullOr(Schema7.Struct({ keys, reason: text3 })), lab: Schema7.NullOr(JoinStateSchema) });
var GroundedJoinActionSchema = Schema7.Union(
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("correct-cell"), ...cellCorrection.fields, expectedRevision: revision2 }),
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("correct-type"), ...typeCorrection.fields, expectedRevision: revision2 }),
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("correct-keys"), keys, reason: text3, expectedRevision: revision2 }),
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("accept-extraction"), expectedRevision: revision2 }),
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("explanation-mode"), mode: Schema7.Literal("quick", "deep", "visual"), expectedRevision: revision2 }),
  Schema7.Struct({ kind: Schema7.Literal("lab"), action: JoinActionSchema, expectedRevision: revision2 })
);
function decode3(schema, value) {
  return Schema7.decodeUnknownSync(schema, { onExcessProperty: "error" })(value);
}
function sameRef2(a, b) {
  return a.sourceId === b.sourceId && a.version === b.version && a.digest === b.digest;
}
function unique3(values) {
  if (new Set(values).size !== values.length) throw Error("Extraction identities must be unique.");
}
function validateData(data) {
  unique3([data.id, data.extraction.id, data.transfer.id, ...[data.extraction.left, data.extraction.right, data.transfer.left, data.transfer.right].flatMap((t) => [t.id, ...t.columns.map((c) => c.id), ...t.rows.map((r) => r.id)])]);
  validateJoinCase(data.transfer);
  unique3(data.citations.map((c) => c.id));
  if (data.basis.kind === "observed-source") unique3(data.basis.sourceRefs.map((r) => r.sourceId));
  const getCitation = (citationId) => {
    const c = data.citations.find((c2) => c2.id === citationId);
    if (!c) throw Error("Every observed table, column and cell needs a supplied citation.");
    return c;
  };
  for (const c of data.citations) {
    if (data.basis.kind !== "observed-source" || !data.basis.sourceRefs.some((r) => sameRef2(r, c.sourceRef))) throw Error("Citation is outside the host-bound source set.");
    if (c.location.kind === "text-range" && c.location.end < c.location.start) throw Error("Invalid citation range.");
    if (c.location.kind === "image-region" && (c.location.x + c.location.width > 1 || c.location.y + c.location.height > 1)) throw Error("Citation region exceeds its source.");
  }
  for (const t of [data.extraction.left, data.extraction.right]) {
    if (data.basis.kind === "observed-source" && getCitation(t.citationId).location.quote !== t.title) throw Error("Observed table title must match its citation.");
    for (const column2 of t.columns) if (data.basis.kind === "observed-source") {
      if (getCitation(column2.citationId).location.quote !== column2.sourceLabel) throw Error("Column mapping must retain its cited source label.");
      if (column2.type !== "unknown" && getCitation(column2.typeCitationId).location.quote !== column2.type) throw Error("A declared observed type needs its exact source citation; otherwise leave the type unknown.");
    }
    for (const row2 of t.rows) {
      if (row2.cells.length !== t.columns.length) throw Error("Each extracted row must map every declared column.");
      for (const value of row2.cells) {
        if (data.basis.kind === "observed-source" && value.kind === "provided") throw Error("Source extraction cannot include uncited invented values.");
        if (value.kind === "provided") continue;
        const c = getCitation(value.citationId);
        if (value.kind === "observed" && c.location.quote !== (value.value === null ? "NULL" : String(value.value))) throw Error("An observed cell must retain its exact cited transcription. Use a user correction for another value.");
      }
    }
  }
  if (data.extraction.join.kind === "mapped" && data.extraction.join.citationId !== null) getCitation(data.extraction.join.citationId);
}
function parse2(value) {
  const data = decode3(GroundedJoinDataSchema, value);
  validateData(data);
  return data;
}
function draftProblem(data, state) {
  const missing = [];
  const table2 = (side) => {
    const t = data.extraction[side];
    const columns = t.columns.map((column2) => {
      const correction = state.typeCorrections.find((c) => c.side === side && c.columnId === column2.id);
      const type = correction?.type ?? column2.type;
      if (type === "unknown") missing.push(`${side}/${column2.id}: choose the column type`);
      return { ...column2, type };
    });
    const rows = t.rows.map((row2) => ({ id: row2.id, values: row2.cells.map((value, index) => {
      const c = state.cellCorrections.find((c2) => c2.side === side && c2.rowId === row2.id && c2.columnId === t.columns[index].id);
      if (c) return c.value;
      if (value.kind === "needs-correction") {
        missing.push(`${side}/${row2.id}/${t.columns[index].id}: ${value.reason}`);
        return void 0;
      }
      return value.value;
    }) }));
    return { id: t.id, title: t.title, columns: columns.map(({ id: id8, label: label2, type }) => ({ id: id8, label: label2, type })), rows };
  };
  const left = table2("left"), right = table2("right");
  const join4 = state.keyCorrection?.keys ?? (data.extraction.join.kind === "mapped" ? data.extraction.join.keys : null);
  if (!join4) missing.push("Choose the join type and both keys explicitly.");
  return { left, right, join: join4, missing };
}
function lesson(data, state) {
  const problem = draftProblem(data, state);
  if (problem.missing.length || !problem.join) throw Error(`Resolve the extraction first: ${problem.missing.join("; ")}`);
  return joinLab.parse({ kind: "join-lab", schemaVersion: 1, id: data.id, version: data.version, title: data.title, source: { sourceId: data.id, version: data.version, digest: data.basis.contextDigest }, practice: { id: data.extraction.id, title: data.extraction.title, left: problem.left, right: problem.right, join: problem.join }, transfer: data.transfer });
}
function parseState3(dataValue, value) {
  const data = parse2(dataValue), state = decode3(GroundedJoinStateSchema, value);
  if (state.contextDigest !== data.basis.contextDigest) throw Error("Saved review belongs to another source/extraction version.");
  unique3(state.cellCorrections.map((c) => `${c.side}/${c.rowId}/${c.columnId}`));
  unique3(state.typeCorrections.map((c) => `${c.side}/${c.columnId}`));
  for (const c of state.cellCorrections) if (!data.extraction[c.side].rows.some((r) => r.id === c.rowId) || !data.extraction[c.side].columns.some((column2) => column2.id === c.columnId)) throw Error("Correction must identify an extracted row and column.");
  for (const c of state.typeCorrections) if (!data.extraction[c.side].columns.some((column2) => column2.id === c.columnId)) throw Error("Type correction must identify an extracted column.");
  if (state.lab) joinLab.parseState(lesson(data, state), state.lab);
  return state;
}
function initial3(dataValue) {
  const data = parse2(dataValue);
  return { kind: "grounded-join", revision: 0, contextDigest: data.basis.contextDigest, mode: "quick", cellCorrections: [], typeCorrections: [], keyCorrection: null, lab: null };
}
function update3(dataValue, stateValue, actionValue) {
  const data = parse2(dataValue), state = parseState3(data, stateValue), action = decode3(GroundedJoinActionSchema, actionValue);
  if (action.expectedRevision !== state.revision) throw Error("The source review changed. Reload its current state.");
  if (state.revision >= 500) throw Error("Create a new lesson version to continue.");
  let next = { ...state, revision: state.revision + 1 };
  if (action.kind === "explanation-mode") next = { ...next, mode: action.mode };
  else if (action.kind === "lab") {
    if (!state.lab) throw Error("Review and accept extracted values before experimenting.");
    next = { ...next, lab: joinLab.update(lesson(data, state), state.lab, action.action) };
  } else {
    if (state.lab) throw Error("The reviewed extraction is fixed. Create a new lesson version to correct it; prior practice and transfer are kept.");
    switch (action.kind) {
      case "correct-cell": {
        const { expectedRevision: _, kind: __, ...c } = action;
        next = { ...next, cellCorrections: [...state.cellCorrections.filter((v) => v.side !== c.side || v.rowId !== c.rowId || v.columnId !== c.columnId), c] };
        break;
      }
      case "correct-type": {
        const { expectedRevision: _, kind: __, ...c } = action;
        next = { ...next, typeCorrections: [...state.typeCorrections.filter((v) => v.side !== c.side || v.columnId !== c.columnId), c] };
        break;
      }
      case "correct-keys":
        next = { ...next, keyCorrection: { keys: action.keys, reason: action.reason } };
        break;
      case "accept-extraction":
        next = { ...next, lab: joinLab.initial(lesson(data, state)) };
        break;
    }
  }
  return parseState3(data, next);
}
function observe2(dataValue, stateValue) {
  const data = parse2(dataValue), state = parseState3(data, stateValue), draft = draftProblem(data, state);
  let problemError = null;
  if (!draft.missing.length) try {
    lesson(data, state);
  } catch (cause) {
    problemError = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Review table types and keys.";
  }
  const lab = state.lab ? joinLab.observe(lesson(data, state), state.lab) : null;
  const origin = data.basis.kind === "local-demo" ? "local-demo" : state.cellCorrections.length || state.typeCorrections.length || state.keyCorrection ? "user-corrected" : "observed-source";
  const count = lab?.observation?.rowCount;
  const change = lab?.change ?? lab?.practiceReview?.change ?? null;
  const stage = lab?.phase.startsWith("transfer") ? "Unseen synthetic transfer" : "Reviewed practice";
  const currentProblemOrigin = stage === "Unseen synthetic transfer" ? "synthetic-transfer" : state.lab && state.lab.practiceEdits > 0 ? "local-experiment" : origin;
  const original = data.extraction.join;
  const joinMapping = original.kind === "mapped" ? { kind: "mapped", origin: data.basis.kind === "local-demo" ? "local-demo" : original.citationId === null ? "proposed-assumption" : "source-cited", keys: original.keys, reason: original.reason, citationId: original.citationId, citation: data.citations.find((c) => c.id === original.citationId) ?? null } : { kind: "ambiguous", origin: "unresolved", reason: original.reason };
  const assumptions = [...data.extraction.assumptions, ...joinMapping.origin === "proposed-assumption" ? [`Proposed join condition (not source-cited): ${joinMapping.reason}`] : []];
  const quick = state.lab ? count === void 0 ? `Predict the result of the ${stage.toLowerCase()}.` : `${count} output rows, computed from the ${lab?.problem.join.mode} join at local revision ${state.lab.revision} (${stage.toLowerCase()}).` : "Review the cited transcription and resolve missing values before running the experiment.";
  const deep = lab?.assessment?.correction ?? "Every equal non-NULL pair produces one row; LEFT also retains unmatched left rows. Exact strings, safe integers and booleans only. No coercion, filters or database collation are modelled.";
  const changeSummary = change ? `${stage === "Unseen synthetic transfer" ? "Practice review before transfer: " : ""}${change.originalCount} \u2192 ${change.currentCount} rows; added: ${change.addedPairIds.join(", ") || "none"}; removed: ${change.removedPairIds.join(", ") || "none"}; changed values: ${change.changedPairIds.join(", ") || "none"}.` : null;
  return { origin, currentProblemOrigin, stage, mode: state.mode, revision: state.revision, sourceRefs: data.basis.kind === "observed-source" ? data.basis.sourceRefs : [], citations: data.citations, assumptions, joinMapping, userJoinCorrection: state.keyCorrection, missing: draft.missing, problemError, ready: !draft.missing.length && !problemError, quick, deep, changeSummary, visual: lab?.observation?.rows ?? [], lab, lesson: state.lab ? lesson(data, state) : null };
}
function readable2(dataValue, stateValue) {
  const data = parse2(dataValue), state = stateValue === void 0 ? initial3(data) : parseState3(data, stateValue), view = observe2(data, state), draft = draftProblem(data, state);
  const column2 = (side, columnId) => `${data.extraction[side].title}.${data.extraction[side].columns.find((c) => c.id === columnId)?.label ?? "Unknown column"}`;
  const row2 = (side, rowId) => `${data.extraction[side].title} row ${data.extraction[side].rows.findIndex((r) => r.id === rowId) + 1}`;
  const keys2 = (value2) => `${value2.mode} equality on ${column2("left", value2.leftColumnId)} = ${column2("right", value2.rightColumnId)}`;
  const value = (cell3) => cell3 === void 0 ? "Needs your correction" : cell3 === null ? "NULL" : typeof cell3 === "string" ? `\u201C${cell3}\u201D` : String(cell3);
  const type = (name2) => name2 === "string" ? "text" : name2 === "integer" ? "whole number" : name2 === "boolean" ? "true or false" : "needs your confirmation";
  const source2 = (ref) => {
    const index = view.sourceRefs.findIndex((item) => sameRef2(item, ref));
    const locations = data.citations.filter((c) => sameRef2(c.sourceRef, ref)).map((c) => c.location.kind);
    const kind = locations.length === 0 ? "bound source" : locations.every((kind2) => kind2 === "text-range") ? "cited text" : locations.every((kind2) => kind2 === "image-region") ? "cited image" : "cited source";
    return `Source ${index + 1} (${kind}), version ${ref.version}`;
  };
  const citationLabel = (citationId) => citationId === null ? "" : `Citation ${data.citations.findIndex((c) => c.id === citationId) + 1}`;
  const mapping = view.joinMapping.kind === "mapped" ? `${view.joinMapping.origin === "source-cited" ? "Source-cited mapping" : view.joinMapping.origin === "local-demo" ? "Local worked example" : "Proposed assumption (no source citation)"}. ${keys2(view.joinMapping.keys)}.
